title: Static and Gravity
author: Marguerite Vasquez
blurb: Hazel Nystrom, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, has spent seven years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
